name: Expedition Adventure
definition: A journey into unfamiliar territory pursues discovery or a distant objective while encounters transform the travelers' priorities and understanding of the place.
diagnostic_questions: Does the unfamiliar place actively change the objective?
Is discovery as important as arrival?

neighbors.distinction: Expedition centers exploration and encounter; quest centers a consequential charge or object.
Expedition retains a discovery objective beyond staying alive.

reader_promises.name: Encounter with the unknown
reader_promises.description: Reveal a place through consequential encounters rather than decorative description.

reader_promises.name: Changing objective
reader_promises.description: Let discoveries revise what success, ownership, or return should mean.

roles.name: Expedition leader
roles.description: Balances mission purpose, risk, and responsibility for others.

roles.name: Local interpreter
roles.description: Challenges the expedition's assumptions about terrain, history, or ownership.

roles.name: Seeker
roles.description: Carries the personal need that makes discovery dangerous or meaningful.

stakes: Integrity of a place or culture
settings: Deep sea, polar, subterranean, or orbital frontier

movements.name: Departure
movements.description: Define the objective, party, route assumptions, and cost of turning back.

movements.name: First encounter
movements.description: Challenge the expedition's model of the territory through a concrete discovery.

movements.name: Deeper crossing
movements.description: Commit beyond easy return as discoveries divide goals or ethics.

movements.name: Return choice
movements.description: Resolve what to take, reveal, protect, or become after the encounter.

complications.name: Map fails
complications.description: The territory changes or prior knowledge encodes a false assumption.

complications.name: Rival claim
complications.description: Another group pursues ownership, credit, extraction, or protection.

complications.name: Discovery cost
complications.description: Learning or proving the truth would damage the place or people discovered.

twists.name: Objective is active
twists.description: The sought place, object, or phenomenon responds to observation or approach.

twists.name: Expedition is the trace
twists.description: Evidence attributed to predecessors was created by the current journey through time, imitation, or manipulation.

conclusions.name: Changed return
conclusions.description: The travelers return with altered knowledge and priorities.

conclusions.name: Protected discovery
conclusions.description: Success requires withholding, disguising, or surrendering the find.

conclusions.name: New frontier
conclusions.description: The destination becomes the beginning of a chosen long-term relationship.

subversions: Treat local knowledge as expertise rather than mystical intuition.
Make refusing extraction the expedition's greatest achievement.
cliches_to_avoid: An empty land waiting to be claimed
Hazards disconnected from the setting's established nature
quality_checks: Each major location changes knowledge or choice.
The conclusion addresses the ethics and meaning of return.

sources.title: The Cambridge Companion to Science Fiction
sources.contribution: Treats speculative fiction as inquiry and combination rather than a single fixed plot.

sources.title: Making It Different: Pushing Genre Boundaries in Fantasy
sources.author_or_organization: Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers Association
sources.contribution: Supports recognizable genre expectations combined with fresh worlds and non-formulaic choices.
